items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Like Bull Moose Jackson, 'you're so ugly you're beautiful.' He was a beautiful man.

ctx.x: He was a terrific prizefighter. When the people on the show would be stranded and nothing happen, he'd book himself down at the YMCA or some club somewhere and go and pick up $20 or $25 and come back and feed somebody, and come back and still do the show. Ironically, a little girl with a penknife, in Cincinnati - he said, "Come on, you girls, and do the show," and she had a little penknife and she stuck it in his side. He bled internally. He was like the fighter they used to call the Angel, that could wind up…
